subject: disable XXH64 autovectorization
perf_evidence: Message: 'disable XXH64 autovectorization using a compiler fence (like XXH32). XXH64 has been reported to be auto-vectorized on AVX512 ... it's generally a bad idea to vectorize XXH64.' Code comment: 'Autovectorization of XXH64 tends to be detrimental'.
change_summary: Adds XXH_COMPILER_GUARD(acc) (empty asm volatile with "+r") at the end of XXH64_round when __AVX512F__ is defined and XXH_ENABLE_AUTOVECTORIZE is not; comment-only change in XXH32_round.

units.name: asm barrier placement (XXH_COMPILER_GUARD in XXH64_round under AVX512F)
units.evidence: The perf change itself is an empty inline-asm optimization barrier; Alive2 cannot model inline asm (only analysable after the runner's asm->freeze rewrite, see next unit)

units.name: XXH64(p,len,seed) one-shot + XXH64 streaming (reset/update/update/digest), -mavx512f, guard modeled as freeze
units.evidence: all 15 targets EQUIV both directions: XXH64 len 0,8,31,32,33,40,63,64,95,96,128 and streaming splits 10+30,40+23,32+32,5+70; asm rewrites old=0 new=148; ir differs for 14/15; no residual calls

units.name: same targets, default x86-64-v3 (no AVX512F): change does not bite
units.evidence: IR identical for all 15 targets (guard compiled out without __AVX512F__); Alive2 EQUIV

notes: Per BRIEF rule 7: the entire perf change is an asm barrier -> unit 'asm barrier placement' is UNSUPPORTED(inline-asm); the C-semantics unit (empty asm '=r,0' rewritten to freeze on both sides by xx_alive.py, i.e. modeled as opaque identity) is EQUIV_BOUNDED at fixed lengths only (no symbolic len). Flags: -O3 -march=x86-64-v3 -mavx512f -fno-vectorize -fno-slp-vectorize -DXXH_NO_INLINE_HINTS=1 -mllvm -inline-threshold=100000, --unroll 8 (streaming finalize loops). Inputs passed BY VALUE (U8ARGS, 128 bytes copied to a local buffer): the first attempt with a raw input pointer (r_avx512_o64) gave REFINES (bwd 'Target is more poisonous than source') only because Alive2 chose poison input bytes, which the new freeze absorbs while the old code propagates poison - not a C-level difference (C callers cannot pass poison). Commit verdict follows METHOD aggregation (UNSUPPORTED dominates).
